positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedSettled
positions.frame: What standing does the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration hold once checked against the June reference plates — declared fact, or still an open question?
positions.why: All three expressions perform the same directional move: an unhedged, present-tense ratification that calibration at 88.4 MHz is complete and holds, verified against a named external standard (June reference plates). src-1 is the prose declaration in Quill's own voice; src-2 and src-3 restate the identical content as structured metadata fields, animated and authored by Xena on Quill's principal footing (fc-1) — a tension in delivery form (free prose vs. labelled-field) but not in direction: both register as native technical voice (register mint-1), both enact authority-ranking by deferring to the reference-plate standard rather than proposing or hedging, and both land at claim-level conviction with competence as the value in play. The group holds together as one settled-status reading even though the footing shifts from direct speech to animated record.
